name: Pricing NCN.2 — National Care Network (Eligible, Route to PX_NCN & Pay) Navigator
description: Walk the Pricing SOP for the PX_NCN event — National Care Network is a third-party vendor that negotiates discounted pricing for (usually non-par) claims, and the PX_NCN soft edit indicates the claim is eligible for external pricing/negotiation and may need to be routed to PX_NCN. Identify the PX_NCN soft edit on the Event Resolution tab and rule out MRU (PX_MJ/PX_MN/PX_MR), special-pricing (Limited Liability / Attachments), and Global transplant (PX_BTD/PX_GTP/PX_BDS/PX_COE/PX_616/PX_CRP/PX_889) events; confirm the Product is Local and the contract state is not VA/CO/NV; click the claim-summary Validate to apply benefits; confirm the Finalization code is PX_P10000 (eligible for PX_NCN review) and the record number is 999 (front-end); check the Provider Information tab for PX_NCN exceptions; confirm no bypass codes are available and click the claim-summary Validate a second time to surface the CHDP/PING routing message; then select Pay and submit to route the claim to PX_NCN.

steps.name: Identify the PX_NCN soft edit and rule out MRU events
steps.description: Review all edits in the Event Resolution tab. The PX_NCN soft edit is highlighted with an error indication — this is the current event to resolve. The PX_NCN event indicates the claim is eligible for external pricing/negotiation and may need to be routed to PX_NCN (National Care Network). Verify the events list for any other events that need to be resolved first per the event hierarchy. Also check for PSCCR (MRU) events by looking for PX_MJ, PX_MN, or PX_MR in the Event Resolution tab — if present, follow the PSCCR events guidelines; if absent, proceed. In this scenario, the claim has no other events and no MRU events, so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Event Resolution tab and reviews the events list, where the active PX_NCN soft edit is highlighted with an error indication and no other events (including MRU PX_MJ/PX_MN/PX_MR) are present.
steps.hint: Open 'Event Resolution' and review the events list. PX_NCN (National Care Network) is the active soft edit, highlighted with an error indication, and there are no other events and no MRU events (PX_MJ/PX_MN/PX_MR), so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the PX_NCN soft edit and rule out MRU events

steps.name: Check for Limited Liability records
steps.description: Check whether Special Pricing records (LOA and LL) apply to the claim. Navigate to the Search tab and open the Limited Liability sub-tab to review any Limited Liability (LL) records present (for example, SPI-MMS LL). In this scenario the search returns 'Limited liability information not found' and 'No active records found', so no special pricing applies and the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Search → Limited Liability sub-tab and confirms no active LL records are present.
steps.hint: Open 'Search' → 'Limited Liability' and review the records. The search shows 'Limited liability information not found' / 'No active records found', so proceed.

steps.name: Verify no special-pricing attachments
steps.description: Review the Attachments tab to verify whether any attachments related to special pricing are loaded on the claim. If no attachment is loaded here, review the Claim Image to look for anything else attached. In this scenario, the PWK section shows no Type or Document number, so the claim has no other special pricing and the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Attachments tab and confirms the PWK section has no loaded attachment (Type / Document number empty).
steps.hint: Open 'Attachment' → 'Attachments' and review the PWK section. There is no Type or Document number, so no special-pricing attachment is loaded — proceed.

steps.name: Check for Global transplant events
steps.description: Determine whether the claim contains Global transplant events by looking for PX_BTD, PX_GTP, PX_BDS, PX_COE, PX_616, PX_CRP, or PX_889 in the Event Resolution tab. If transplant events are present, follow the Transplant events guidelines; if absent, proceed. In this scenario, the claim does not contain any transplant events, so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee re-reviews the Event Resolution events list for Global transplant codes (PX_BTD/PX_GTP/PX_BDS/PX_COE/PX_616/PX_CRP/PX_889) and confirms none are present.
steps.hint: Back on 'Event Resolution', scan the events list for transplant codes (PX_BTD, PX_GTP, PX_BDS, PX_COE, PX_616, PX_CRP, PX_889). None are present, so proceed.

steps.name: Check the Line of Business via Product field
steps.description: Determine whether the claim is ITS-Host or another Line of Business (LOB) by navigating to the Member Information tab, then the Group section, and reviewing the Product field. If the Product value is ITS-Host, follow the alternate SOP guidelines. If the Product field displays any other value, such as Local, National, or ACA, proceed to the next step. In this scenario, the Product is Local; therefore, the claim is not ITS-Host, and the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Member Information tab and confirms the Product field reads Local.
steps.hint: Open 'Member Info' and read the Product field under the Group section. It reads 'Local' (not ITS-Host), so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Check the Line of Business via Product field

steps.name: Verify the contract state is not VA, CO, or NV
steps.description: Verify the contract state by navigating to the Search tab,then the Benefit sub-tab and note the contract state  from the Contract State field . The state must not be VA, CO, or NV; if it is one of those, follow the alternate guidelines, otherwise proceed. In this scenario, the contract state is CA, so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Search → Benefit sub-tab and confirms the Contract state is CA (not VA/CO/NV).
steps.hint: Open 'Search' → 'Benefit' and read the Contract state field. It reads 'CA' — not VA, CO, or NV — so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Verify the contract state is not VA, CO, or NV

steps.name: Validate to apply benefits
steps.description: Navigate to the claim summary and click the Validate button. When Validate is clicked, the application applies the benefits to the claim. Verify that the correct benefits have been applied before proceeding (the Validation section shows 'Benefits applied'). In this scenario, the correct benefits are applied, so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee clicks the claim-summary Validate button, which applies the benefits and surfaces the 'Benefits applied' confirmation in the Validation section.
steps.hint: Click the 'Validate' button in the claim summary. The application applies the benefits — confirm the Validation section shows 'Benefits applied', then proceed.

steps.name: Verify PX_NCN eligibility and front-end record
steps.description: Confirm the claim is eligible for PX_NCN review and is on the front-end record. Navigate to the Payment Information tab and check the Finalization code field. If the finalization code is PX_R00000, the claim is not eligible for PX_NCN review; if it is anything other than PX_R00000 (such as PX_D00000 or PX_P10000), the claim is eligible. Then check the record number shown next to the DCN number in the header — 999 indicates the front end, anything else indicates an adjustment. In this scenario, the finalization code is PX_P10000 (claim is eligible for PX_NCN review) and the record number is 999 (front end), so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Payment Information tab and reads the Finalization code (PX_P10000 — eligible for PX_NCN review) and the record number (999 — front-end).
steps.hint: Open 'Payment Information' and read the Finalization code — it reads 'PX_P10000' (not PX_R00000), so the claim IS eligible for PX_NCN review. Confirm the record number next to the DCN is '999' (front end), then proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Verify PX_NCN eligibility and front-end record

steps.name: Check for PX_NCN exceptions
steps.description: Check whether the claim qualifies for any PX_NCN exceptions by reviewing the applicable provider and claim information. First, navigate to the Provider Information tab, then the Billing section, and review the National State field to determine whether the services were rendered within the United States. Foreign claims involve services received outside U.S. states. In this scenario, the National State is CA (California), confirming that the claim is not a foreign claim. Next, review the Provider Name field in the same Billing section to determine whether the claim involves a Colorado County Health Pool nonparticipating chiropractor billing for a Department of Transportation physical. Finally, determine whether the claim falls under any other exception specifically approved by OE. If any of these exceptions apply, follow the alternate guidelines. If no exceptions apply, proceed to the next step. In this scenario, none of the PX_NCN exceptions apply; therefore, the trainee may proceed to the next step.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Provider Information tab and confirms no PX_NCN exception applies — the National State is within the US (CA) and the provider is not a Colorado County Health Pool nonparticipating chiropractor.
steps.hint: Open 'Provider Info'. Check the National State field (CA — within the US, so not a foreign claim) and the provider Name (not a Colorado County Health Pool nonparticipating chiropractor). No exception applies, so proceed.

steps.name: Check bypass codes and validate for PX_NCN routing
steps.description: Route the claim to PX_NCN by confirming that all required bypass codes are applied. On the Event Resolution tab, apply any available bypass codes from the bypass field. In this scenario, no bypass codes are available, so none need to be applied. Then click the Validate button in the claim summary a second time. Because no bypass codes are shown on the events list, the system responds with the message 'SUBMIT THE CLAIM TO LOG TO BATCH CHDP CLAIM ELIGIBLE FOR PING', confirming the claim is eligible for routing.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee confirms no bypass codes are available and clicks the claim-summary Validate button a SECOND time. state.actions.validate.completesStepId is the ordered list ["step_007", "step_010"]: the first press applied the benefits (step_007), and this press — gated on step_010 being the active step, so steps 008/009 cannot be skipped — surfaces the CHDP/PING routing message -- written into the Validation section's System message field via state.actions.validate.writesByStep, and toasted. Both are armed by this same completion, so they cannot disagree.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution' there are no bypass codes to apply. Click the claim-summary 'Validate' button again — the system responds 'SUBMIT THE CLAIM TO LOG TO BATCH CHDP CLAIM ELIGIBLE FOR PING', so proceed.
steps.checklistItem: Check bypass codes and validate for PX_NCN routing
steps.completionToast: SUBMIT THE CLAIM TO LOG TO BATCH CHDP CLAIM ELIGIBLE FOR PING

steps.name: Submit Pay decision and route to PX_NCN
steps.description: Navigate to the Decision section in the header, select 'Pay' from the dropdown menu and click Submit. Once Submit is clicked, the system automatically routes the claim to PX_NCN.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee confirms the Pay decision in the submit dialog.
steps.hint: Pick 'Pay' from the Decision dropdown in the claim header, then click Submit and confirm in the dialog.
steps.checklistItem: Submit Pay decision and route to PX_NCN
